description: This file defines the TransactionalStateAttribute class, which is a custom attribute used to specify transactional state metadata in the Orleans Transactions framework. It contains properties for state and storage names and is used as an attribute on method parameters.

classes.name: TransactionalStateAttribute
classes.description: A custom attribute class used to mark method parameters with transactional state metadata within Orleans Transactions.

methods.name: TransactionalStateAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attribute with a state name and optional storage name.
